title: Handle shell post hooks cheaply only when no full-handler work is needed
context: Shell post hooks previously fell through to the full handler, including observations that needed only bookkeeping.
decision: Add a lightweight shell post path guarded by write inspection and pipeline state. Fall back to the full handler when fingerprinting fails, writes are detected, stored lessons exist, or a proof reminder is required. Advance the shell baseline only after accepting the observation.
consequences: Eligible shell post hooks record observations and save proof state without invoking the full handler.
Rejected observations preserve the shell baseline for the full handler.
Fingerprint failure is treated as uncertainty, not evidence of no writes.
alternatives_rejected: Route every shell post hook through the full handler.
Advance the shell baseline before deciding whether the lightweight path can handle the event.

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Route every shell post hook through the full handler.
Advance the shell baseline before deciding whether the lightweight path can handle the event.
